This small pilot is not eligible for model selection and has one table page.

territory of Vietnam.

“Charter Capital” means the total aggregate par value of outstanding shares of the

Company and as mentioned in Article 6 of this Charter.

“The Law on Enterprises” means the Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 passed
